resources.string: Turnip Space runs apps and games inside a managed virtual space (no root required) and lets you load custom Adreno Turnip Vulkan drivers from AdrenoTools-compatible .zip files into apps launched through it.
Please read carefully before using the app. We will not promise anything the engineering does not support.
Shizuku unlocks extra GPU diagnostics via privileged shell commands. It is entirely optional: without it the app still works with reduced diagnostics and never crashes.
Custom Turnip drivers can only be applied to code running inside this app-controlled process. A driver cannot be force-injected into an arbitrary installed app that was never built for it.

Apps and games with heavy native engines (Unity, Unreal) load their own native libraries; universal compatibility with every Play Store APK is not guaranteed, especially on Android 13+ where hidden-API restrictions are stricter.
Turnip supports Adreno 6xx, 7xx and newer GPUs only. Adreno 5xx and older devices must keep the proprietary driver.
The virtual space is a best-effort plugin runtime: simple and mid-complexity apps generally work; some apps may refuse to start, and the app will always tell you why instead of crashing.
Nothing is written outside this app sandbox. All APKs, drivers and logs stay in Turnip Space private storage.
Create a space, import an APK and pick a Turnip driver to get started.
